## Functional summary
The 160-amino-acid sequence is an **exact match** to reviewed UniProt protein **Q2J543** from *Frankia casuarinae*, annotated as **2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 2,4-cyclodiphosphate synthase (IspF; EC 4.6.1.12)**. This enzyme catalyzes the conversion of CDP-ME2P to ME-CPP, releasing CMP. It acts in the **methylerythritol phosphate (MEP) pathway**, at step 4 of 6 in the biosynthesis of IPP and DMAPP—the building blocks of isoprenoids. The reference annotation reports binding of one divalent metal cation per subunit.

- **Pfam domain:** YgbB (PF02542), residues 8–157

The mass, pI, and other sequence-derived values are estimates and do not account for protein processing or modifications. The function is strongly supported by the exact sequence match and curated reference annotation.
